description: Defines the InvokableMethodId struct which uniquely identifies an invokable method within the Orleans code generator, including proxy info, interface type, and method symbol.

classes.name: InvokableMethodId
classes.description: A readonly struct that uniquely identifies an invokable method, including proxy base info, interface type, and method symbol, with equality and string representation implementations.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another InvokableMethodId instance based on proxy base, method, and interface type.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.Equals to compare with another object, returning true if it is an InvokableMethodId and equal.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on proxy base, method, and interface type.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation combining proxy base, interface type name, and method name.
